name: test_cia_flags_recursively
description: Stores a constant in the shared global, then tests bits 0, 1 and 2 of that value and calls the same unnamed routine once for each set bit. The referenced CIA-B interrupt control and interrupt request registers are the hardware the calls work with.

name: call_when_flag_set
description: Calls an unnamed routine only when the shared flag variable is non-zero, and returns immediately otherwise.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Body is a bare return with no work, so the routine does nothing when called.

name: set_global_to_minus_one
description: Writes an all-ones value (minus one) into the shared global variable and returns.

name: subtract_adjacent_words_into_records
description: Walks four pointer-table entries, each covering fifty words: every word becomes its difference from the next word, clamped to 900 when negative, and a quarter of that value is written into a byte of a 12-byte record.

name: stub_infinite_loop
description: Contains only an infinite loop with no exit, so control never returns from it; the decompiler's removed unreachable block adds nothing to the behaviour.

name: dispatch_on_zero_register
description: Branches on whether the value in one data register is zero: the zero path calls one unnamed routine, while the other path calls two unnamed routines and three further routines with the second data register and a zero argument.

name: enable_dma_and_poll_loop
description: Writes a DMA control value with the set bit and the DMA-enable bit into the shared global, then loops calling three unnamed routines, storing their results into a table and counting down before it exits.

name: poll_port_status_flags
description: Compares the shared status value with a byte at offset 32 of a record and returns the status when they match and a bit-two test passes. Otherwise it polls up to four times for a non-zero status and returns minus one. The status comes from the CIA-A port register.

name: split_offset_into_blocks
description: Looks up a start value and a second value from a table indexed by a scaled index. It then divides a combined byte count by 512 into a block number and a remainder, storing both plus a derived count in the record.

name: write_xored_value_then_delay
description: Stores a value looked up by index from the shared table, exclusive-ORed with 125, into the shared variable, then spins a counter through about twenty thousand iterations as a delay. The CIA-B port B register is touched.

name: parse_digit_after_tag
description: Calls an unnamed routine; when it returns zero and the word begins with the tag "ETC", it returns the final character as a decimal digit, otherwise it returns minus one.

name: convert_status_to_flag
description: Calls an unnamed routine and returns zero when its result is zero and minus one otherwise, turning a status into a success flag.

name: match_status_against_record
description: Returns the result of an unnamed routine when it is non-negative and its low byte equals a byte at offset 32 of the record, and a second unnamed routine also reports zero; otherwise it returns minus one.

name: reset_flags_on_minus_three
description: When the code argument equals minus three, sets the shared variable to all ones twice; for any other code it calls two unnamed routines with the argument.

name: step_track_sectors_with_fill
description: Splits a sector position by eleven into a track index and an in-track sector index, then steps across the track in sector-sized chunks until the requested length is used up. When a mode flag equals minus two it first fills a block of 4096 longwords with an alternating one-zero bit pattern.

name: fill_pattern_table_if_needed
description: Fills 417 longwords, starting at a pointer taken from a record, with an alternating one-zero bit pattern, but only when the first longword does not already hold that pattern.

name: mark_slot_if_index_high
description: Repeats up to ten times: calls an unnamed routine and, when a field of the record is zero, reads a byte from another unnamed routine. If that byte is eleven or more it marks a slot in the shared array with minus one, otherwise it returns.

name: write_mfm_sync_words
description: Writes the MFM sync word repeated as a longword into a buffer at offsets computed from a sector counter modulo eleven, waits between writes, and repeats for the requested count. It then polls until a status equals twenty-eight.

name: program_blitter_bit_mask_passes
description: Writes the blitter control, pointer and size registers for three passes, with a value derived from the sector offset in the size register for the first pass, and runs blitter operations between the register writes.

name: cycle_sector_index_modulo_eleven
description: Computes a starting position as a sum taken modulo eleven, then runs a loop of the given count that calls an unnamed routine and advances the position by one, wrapping back to zero after ten.

name: program_blitter_copy_pass
description: Derives three blitter pointers from an input value and two address arguments, writes the blitter control registers and a size computed from the input shifted left by two with a fixed low bit, then calls an unnamed routine.

name: validate_sector_sync_and_header
description: Checks a sector's sync and preamble longwords against the expected alternating one-zero pattern and the MFM sync word, compares a repeated decoded value on each entry, and returns one of several numbered error codes when a check fails.

name: update_byte_bit7_from_flag
description: Reads a target byte and the flag bit in the byte before it. When that flag is clear it sets the top bit of the target unless bit six is already set; when the flag is set it clears the top bit. The target byte is written back.

name: verify_block_xor_checksum
description: XOR-accumulates the alternating-bit-masked longwords of a ten-longword block and compares the result with a value from an unnamed routine plus a checksum byte from the record. It returns zero when both match, otherwise a numbered error code.

name: decode_mfm_long_pair
description: Takes two consecutive longwords, masks each with the alternating one-zero bit pattern, shifts the first left by one and combines the two into one decoded longword, recovering the data bits from the odd and even halves.

name: xor_checksum_table
description: XORs together a run of longwords whose count is set by a quarter of the length argument, then masks the result with the alternating one-zero pattern and returns it.

name: shift_bits_across_long_pair
description: Shifts a longword left by sixteen minus the count and the following word right by the count, then joins the shifted parts into one longword result.

name: run_three_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls three unnamed routines in sequence with no other work of its own.

name: compute_clock_bits_and_store
description: Inverts the data bits in the alternating-bit positions, derives a shifted mask from neighbouring bits, and stores the mask combined with the data bits through a pointer. When the flag byte before the pointer is set, the top bit of the mask is cleared first.

name: find_sector_marker_index
description: Scans a buffer of words for runs of the alternating sync fill values, skipping repeats, and when a word matches an entry in a fixed table it returns that entry's position; if the scan reaches the end of the buffer it returns minus one.

name: start_blitter_or_copy_word
description: When the flag argument is non-zero it copies one word from the buffer before the pointer to a destination through an unnamed routine. Otherwise it programs the blitter control, shift and size registers from a rounded length and starts one pass.

name: start_blitter_decode_pass
description: Programs the blitter control, shift and size registers from a shifted parameter and a length rounded up to a multiple of sixty-four, sets the pointer registers, and calls an unnamed routine.

name: initialise_disk_controller_fields
description: Writes a disk DMA enable value to the DMA control register at the record base, stores minus one in one field, stores the alternating one-zero fill pattern in another, and clears three state fields.

name: configure_and_start_disk_read
description: When the zero flag is set it points the disk DMA pointer at a buffer inside the record, writes the ADKCON control value, enables disk DMA, writes a disk length word that starts a read, and then calls an unnamed routine.

name: start_disk_write_dma
description: When a status bit is set, points the disk DMA pointer at the record buffer, writes the ADKCON control value, enables disk DMA and starts a write with a fixed length word, then calls an unnamed routine. Otherwise it returns twenty-eight.

name: wait_for_disk_status_bit
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then polls a status word until bit one is set, recording two in a counter and returning zero. If the shared flag becomes non-zero first it returns minus one, and it writes a fixed word to another field either way.

name: clear_bit_in_shared_byte
description: Clears one bit of the data-register byte, with the bit number taken from a word plus three, and stores the result in the shared variable. The CIA-B port B register is among the hardware referenced.

name: poll_shared_flag_bit_five
description: Sets the shared variable to all ones, calls two unnamed routines, then returns zero when bit five of the shared variable is clear while the variable is zero, or thirty-four when the variable is non-zero with that bit set.

name: step_head_to_target_track
description: Compares the target track argument with the cylinder stored in the table entry for this drive, calls an unnamed routine once per cylinder of difference to step the head, then records the new track in the table and returns zero.

name: wait_for_port_bit_four
description: Repeatedly calls an unnamed routine until bit four of the shared variable clears, then zeroes an indexed slot and returns zero. If the bit is still set after 86 attempts it returns thirty.

name: update_status_bits_and_call
description: Reads a status byte from an unnamed routine, clears its bit one when the argument byte is non-negative, forces bit zero on, stores the result in the shared variable, and calls another unnamed routine. The CIA-B port B register is referenced.

name: store_result_then_call
description: Stores the value returned by one unnamed routine in the shared variable and then calls a second unnamed routine. The CIA-B port B register is among the hardware referenced.

name: wait_until_flag_nonzero
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then loops until the shared variable becomes non-zero before returning.

name: clear_cia_registers_and_flag
description: Writes zero to four CIA register locations spread across the CIA address space and clears the shared variable. The CIA-B interrupt control register and the CIA-A port A register are referenced.

name: access_cia_port_b_register
description: The decompiled body is unavailable, so the behaviour is taken from register use alone: it references the CIA-B port B register and is called from two places.

name: fill_table_with_stepped_addresses
description: Writes the high and low words of a value into a table of five entries at a fixed address, adding forty to the value on each step so the entries hold addresses forty bytes apart.

name: set_copper_list_pointers
description: Swaps two stored longword addresses, writes the high and low words of the first into four table entries at a fixed address, stepping forty bytes each time, then writes a copper list location to the copper first-location register. The copper jump register is referenced.

name: advance_state_and_clear_blocks
description: Decrements a shared countdown and, when it reaches zero, steps a six-state counter, calls an unnamed routine and dispatches on the new state. The selected states clear forty-nine pairs of longwords at addresses computed from the counter.

name: decode_packed_rows_into_buffer
description: Reads a stream of bytes: a byte with the top bit set ends the decode, a zero byte ends a group, and any other byte selects a table entry whose sixteen words are copied into the destination with a forty-byte row stride.

name: clear_then_decode_packed_rows
description: Clears a thousand-longword destination buffer, then reads a stream of packed bytes, copying table entries with a forty-byte row stride until an end marker.

key: myth - history in the making (1992)(system 3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr csl]/Myth - History in the Making (1992)(System 3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CSL].adf:bootblock:0:000C
name: allocate_memory_and_do_io
description: The decompiled body is unavailable, so the behaviour is taken from its library calls: it calls the system routines for absolute and general memory allocation and a device I/O request, and writes the background colour register.

key: myth - history in the making (1992)(system 3)(disk 1 of 3)[cr csl]/Myth - History in the Making (1992)(System 3)(Disk 1 of 3)[cr CSL].adf:bootblock:0:0300
name: build_io_request_and_dispatch
description: Fills fields of a request block with a length, a buffer address and a second length, calls a library function at offset minus 456, sets a further field and a counter, calls that library function again, and then calls the routine at the loaded address.

name: wait_then_clear_long_block
description: Waits until the shared variable reaches one hundred, calls three unnamed routines, sets the shared variable to small values and calls two more routines, then clears a ten-thousand-entry block of longwords.

name: clear_ten_thousand_longwords
description: Writes zero to ten thousand consecutive longwords starting at a fixed address and returns.

name: service_highest_pending_flag_bit
description: Checks bits six, five and four of the shared variable in that order. The first set bit causes one unnamed routine to be called and the variable to be set to that bit's value (64, 32 or 16). The interrupt request registers are referenced.

name: write_countdown_to_global
description: Writes each value from 256 down to zero into the shared variable in turn, so the variable ends at zero. The background colour register is among the hardware referenced.

name: reset_flag_and_delay
description: Sets the shared variable to one, then spins a counter through forty-one iterations as a short delay and returns.

name: increment_and_clear_flag_calls
description: Increments the shared variable and, when the result is non-zero, calls an unnamed routine and calls another when the result is negative. It then clears the variable, calls an unnamed routine, and calls one more when the variable is non-zero.

name: step_palette_colours_toward_target
description: Selects one of three colour tables by a shared mode value, then walks its entries, moving each 4-bit red, green and blue component one step toward the matching component of a fixed reference table. The entry count is 30, 31 or 15 depending on the mode.

name: install_jump_vector_stub
description: Calls a function through the base pointer, then writes a jump instruction word and the address of an unnamed routine into a fixed memory slot, and calls ten unnamed routines to set up the environment.

name: patch_jsr_then_dispatch_indirect
description: Writes JSR-style instruction words and routine addresses into four memory locations, calls an unnamed routine, then makes an indirect call through a jump table that could not be recovered.

name: copy_code_block_into_place
description: Stores a JSR-style instruction word and a routine address in the global area, calls an unnamed routine, then copies bytes from the global area up to a fixed end address, advancing both pointers, and calls a second routine.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The decompiled body runs into bad instruction data and halts there. Only a word update two entries forward and a store through a pointer are readable, so no further behaviour can be attributed.

name: read_shifted_longword_with_flag
description: Writes a no-operation instruction word to a global, calls an unnamed routine, and returns the longword four bytes before the pointer shifted right by one with its top bit set.

name: advance_pointer_and_dispatch
description: Adds 512 to a shared word, writes JSR-style instruction words and routine addresses into memory, calls an unnamed routine, then makes an indirect call through a jump table that could not be recovered.

name: copy_block_to_fixed_limit
description: Stores a jump-style instruction word and a routine address in the global area, calls an unnamed routine, then copies a byte block up to a fixed limit with both pointers advancing, and calls a second routine. The decompiled tail is incomplete.

name: patch_calls_then_jump
description: Writes JSR-style instruction words that call unnamed routines into four memory locations, calls one unnamed routine, and then calls the code at a fixed absolute address.

name: patch_handler_code_sequences
description: Tests a shared word against a sentinel value and, when it matches, writes sequences of JSR, JMP and no-operation instruction words with routine addresses into memory, adding one more patch when a flag is set. The decompiled body ends with bad instruction data.

name: call_indirect_from_table
description: Loads a code pointer from a fixed offset within a shared table and calls it, then returns. It performs no other operations.

name: spin_forever_without_exit
description: Contains only an infinite loop with no exit; the decompiler removed unreachable blocks, and the keyboard serial register is listed among the hardware this routine touches.

name: halt_in_endless_loop
description: Contains only an infinite loop with no exit; the decompiler removed unreachable blocks, and the vertical beam position register is listed among the hardware this routine touches.

name: start_blit_and_wait
description: Writes a fixed blitter size value at offset 88 of the base record, then loops while bit six of the shared variable is set, returning when it clears. The blitter-busy wait is among the called routines.

name: dispatch_on_scaled_length
description: Multiplies the low word of the first argument by 5632 and compares the product with a fixed constant. A mismatch calls a function-table entry and returns; a match calls an unnamed routine and then another table entry.

name: run_handler_when_check_zero
description: Calls an unnamed routine and then a function-table entry; when that entry returns zero it calls a second table entry, an unnamed routine and a further table entry.

name: call_table_entry_after_call
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then calls the code pointer at a fixed offset in the record, and returns.

name: forward_call_then_return
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns, passing control through unchanged.

name: stub_empty_return_text_ref
description: Body is a bare return with no work. The routine is called from three places and is recorded as referring to the text Gainforce.High, which the body itself does not use.

name: wait_flag_then_set_one
description: When a configuration word is non-zero, waits while bit seven of the shared variable is set, then sets the variable to one once bit six is clear. When the word is zero it sets the variable to one directly. The CIA-A port A register is referenced.

name: issue_device_io_request
description: Fills in a device request block with a length, a start address and a data pointer, calls the system I/O routine, and returns its result. The boot block entry is the caller.

name: copy_relocated_block_to_limit
description: Copies bytes from the loaded block into a destination area, advancing both pointers up to a fixed limit, then calls four unnamed routines. The colour register sixteen is listed among the hardware this routine touches.

name: store_byte_and_return_shifted
description: Reads the longword four bytes before a pointer, stores a word built from one byte of it and a byte of the second argument through another pointer, and returns the value shifted right by one with its top bit set.

name: shift_bit_stream_bits
description: Shifts a bit register right by one for a count given by the argument, reloading it from an unnamed routine whenever its bits run out, and returns when the count is used up.

name: copy_large_block_to_limit
description: Copies a large block of bytes from the loaded data into a destination area, advancing both pointers until a fixed limit is reached, then calls unnamed routines. A colour-table register is written.

name: store_byte_and_return_shifted
description: Reads the longword four bytes before a pointer, stores a word built from one byte of it and a byte of the second argument through another pointer, and returns the value shifted right by one with its top bit set.

name: shift_bit_stream_bits
description: Shifts a bit register right by one for a count given by the argument, reloading it from an unnamed routine whenever its bits run out, and returns when the count is used up.

name: shift_right_set_top_bit
description: Shifts the data register right by one, sets the top bit of the result, and returns it.

name: initialise_display_and_audio
description: Saves the shared variable, clears about fifteen thousand longwords at a fixed address, writes the copper location and the DMA and interrupt enable values, fills table entries with addresses, and calls three unnamed routines. Audio channels are switched off through a called routine.

name: acknowledge_interrupt_and_reset
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then when the shared variable is non-zero calls four more routines. It calls one further routine and sets the variable to thirty-two. The interrupt request register is referenced.

name: scan_name_token_with_wildcard
description: Scans a text buffer from a stored position for the end of a name token, treating an asterisk as a wildcard and stopping at separators such as space, dot, colon, slash and equals, then records the next position and a length in shared words.

name: scan_name_token_and_store
description: Scans a text buffer for the end of a name token like its neighbour does for names, but stores the resulting position and a length through an unnamed routine and returns nothing.

name: append_table_entry_record
description: Finds the first empty fourteen-byte entry in a table, stores a pointer and two adjusted coordinates in it, then sets a count of four and clears two fields.

name: add_table_record_without_return
description: Finds the first empty fourteen-byte entry in a table, stores a pointer and two adjusted coordinates in it, then sets a count of four and clears two fields. It returns nothing.

name: advance_table_records_each_frame
description: Walks nineteen fourteen-byte table entries, adds per-step offsets from lookup tables to each entry's two coordinates, steps its index, and decrements a counter that is reset to four when it runs out.

name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two unnamed routines in sequence and returns.

name: call_routine_between_guarded_calls
description: Calls one unnamed routine unconditionally, and calls another before and after it only when the argument is non-zero.

name: clear_word_block
description: Writes zero into the given number of consecutive words starting at the pointer and returns.

name: build_division_offset_table
description: Fills a table of words, one per count step, with values taken from dividing a fixed constant by the count argument, accumulating the quotient each time and scaling the high byte by 132.

name: call_routine_return_if_nonzero
description: Calls one unnamed routine when the argument is non-zero, calls another unconditionally, then calls a third and returns its result only when the argument is non-zero, otherwise returning zero.

name: repeat_call_until_zero
description: Calls an unnamed routine repeatedly until the value it returns is zero, then returns.

name: repeat_call_until_zero
description: Calls an unnamed routine repeatedly until the value it returns is zero, then returns.

name: clear_bit_column_across_rows
description: For each of twelve table entries, clears one bit selected by a column value in three bitplane rows spaced forty bytes apart when the entry is zero; other entries take a separate branch that writes the same rows.

name: clear_bit_down_column_rows
description: Clears one bit, chosen by a column value, in each of thirty-six bytes spaced forty bytes apart, starting at a pointer computed from the column.

name: pass_argument_through_unchanged
description: Its guard requires the shared variable to be both non-zero and zero, which cannot hold, so the inner call never runs and the routine returns its argument unchanged.

name: return_after_dead_guard
description: Its guard requires the shared variable to be both non-zero and zero, which cannot hold, so the inner call never runs and the routine returns without doing anything.

name: queue_blit_rectangle_at_position
description: Computes a byte address from x and y coordinates using a 120-byte row stride and a fixed base, waits until the blitter is idle, then programs the blitter control, mask and size registers for a rectangle.

name: queue_blit_clear_rectangle
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, then sets a blitter control value and fill mode for a rectangle, computing the destination address from coordinates with a 120-byte row stride and storing the modulo and size values.

name: clear_key_code_flag
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then clears the shared word to minus one when it was non-negative; when the previous value was ninety-five it also sets a counter to 1452.

name: read_keyboard_serial_byte
description: When bit three of the shared variable is set, marks bit six, calls an unnamed routine for the keyboard serial exchange, clears bit six and returns its value; otherwise it returns 127. The keyboard serial register is referenced.

name: track_key_repeat_delay
description: Calls an unnamed routine to obtain a key code. A non-negative code is stored with a repeat flag and a counter, a negative code clears the flag and sets the counter to ten, and while the flag is set the counter counts down.

name: step_colour_fade_with_counter
description: Counts down a shared step counter and, when it wraps, runs a loop that moves the 4-bit red, green and blue fields of a colour entry by table deltas toward a target, counting how many components changed.

name: adjust_colour_components_toward_target
description: When the shared flag is non-zero, moves the 4-bit red, green and blue fields of a colour entry toward a target by table deltas and counts the components that changed.

name: set_audio_channel_volumes
description: Walks a sound table in a loop, selecting entries against a running threshold, and writes the four audio channel volume registers from the selected values.

name: update_audio_channel_playback
description: Decrements a set of shared counters, then loads start addresses, lengths and volumes for the four audio channels from stored sample tables, and calls three unnamed routines.

name: load_sample_channel_registers
description: Copies a longword from a sample table into a record and takes a nibble from it; when the nibble is non-zero it looks up a thirty-byte channel entry and loads the audio channel start address, length and volume values, using a masking subroutine that reduces a word to twelve bits.

name: update_sample_channel_state
description: Masks a record word to twelve bits; when the low bits are zero it copies a value and returns, otherwise it picks an entry from a counter modulo three and updates the channel record fields, using the masking subroutine for the comparison. The fire-button and disk status register is referenced.

name: initialise_copper_and_blitter
description: Clears about seven thousand longwords at a fixed address, points the copper list at a routine address, writes DMA and interrupt control values, waits for the blitter to become idle, then programs the blitter pointers, mask and size registers.

name: call_through_stored_pointer
description: Calls the routine whose address is stored in a fixed pointer slot and returns.

name: adjust_colour_components_toward_target
description: When the shared flag is non-zero, moves the 4-bit red, green and blue fields of a colour entry toward a target by table deltas and counts the components that changed.

name: stub_immediate_return_routine
description: Body is a bare return with no work.

name: stub_bare_return_entry
description: Body is a bare return with no work, so the routine does nothing when called.

name: stub_bare_return_tail
description: Body is a bare return with no work, so the routine does nothing when called.
